blocks.html: This documentation provides a reference to the `validateCartShippingOptionsPriceStep`. It belongs to the `@medusajs/medusa/core-flows` package.

This step validates shipping options to ensure they have a price.
If not valid, the step throws an error.

children.name: shippingOptions
children.description:
The shipping option's details. Should have a `calculated_price.calculated_amount`
to be considered valid.
